INR 80,000 – INR 1,20,000 per month (commensurate with experience)

content_sections.heading: About IISER TVM
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Thiruvananthapuram (IISER TVM) is an autonomous institute established by the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The institute is dedicated to scientific research and science education, offering five-year BS-MS, M.Sc., Integrated Ph.D. and Ph.D. programmes.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Teachers retired from academic service are eligible for appointment. The maximum age limit for applying is 65 years. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

rows.post: Adhoc Faculty for Teaching Courses in Humanities (2026)
rows.qualification: Ph.D. in Economics, History of Science, English language and literature, Development Studies, Philosophy and closely related fields
rows.experience: Teaching experience at university/college level (or equivalent) is desirable

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging from INR 80,000 to INR 1,20,000, which will be commensurate with their experience. The position is purely on an adhoc basis for teaching courses in humanities.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview. Candidates unable to attend the interview in person may request to attend the interview online.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER TVM Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the institute website to access the official application form. Fill out the application form completely with all requisite academic and professional details. Open the online registration link provided by the institute. Upload the duly filled application form along with all required supporting documents. Submit the online form before the closing deadline on 15 November 2026 (11:59 PM).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form Curriculum Vitae (CV) Scanned copy of Certificates Experience Certificates, if any Identity Proof

content_sections.heading: Contact Details
content_sections.text: For any queries regarding the application, candidates may contact: dofa.secy[at]iisertvm[dot]ac[dot]in

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IISER TVM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online registration form along with supporting documents is 15 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for IISER TVM Adhoc Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. in Economics, History of Science, English language and literature, Development Studies, Philosophy or closely related fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for Adhoc Faculty at IISER TVM?
faq.answer: The appointed faculty will receive a salary of INR 80,000 to INR 1,20,000 per month, commensurate with experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for IISER TVM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 65 years as specified in the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q5. Can retired teachers apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, teachers retired from academic service are explicitly eligible for appointment.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for IISER TVM Adhoc Faculty?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview, with an option to request an online interview if unable to attend in person.

faq.question: Q7. Can the interview be attended online?
faq.answer: Yes, shortlisted candidates who are unable to attend the interview in person may request to attend the interview online.

faq.question: Q8. What documents must be uploaded with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must upload their Curriculum Vitae, scanned copies of certificates, experience certificates (if any) and an identity proof.
